title: Shared bicycle key cabinet
text:
Shared bicycle key cabinet

The shared bicycle key cabinet is in the east lobby beside the visitor desk. Its inventory reference is cobaltmesa418. Return a borrowed bicycle key to this cabinet before leaving the building.

title: Travel expense submission update
text:
Travel expense submission update

Travel expense packets must now be submitted within eleven calendar days after returning from a business trip. Include the itinerary and available receipts in the expense portal. This replacement policy carries the update marker ledgermint604.
